info.name: OceanEye API
info.description:
Complete manual-test suite for the OceanEye drowning-risk detection prototype.

**Nothing is hardcoded.** Every id (beach, camera, upload, job, event, alert) is captured from an earlier response into a collection variable. Run the folders in order the first time; after that any folder works on its own as long as `00 · Health` has run.

**Authentication** is development mode: an `X-Dev-Role` header of `operator`, `lifeguard`, `administrator` or `service`. That is not security — it exists so the role boundaries can be built and tested before a real identity provider is wired in. The server refuses to start in production with this mode on.

Set `base_url` in the environment. Full walkthrough: `docs/testing.md`.
